messages.text: James, CDPH has flagged three ICU night shifts in early October as potential ratio violations. Shifts SH-1008, SH-1014, SH-1020. The inspector says the charge nurse RN-ICU-003 (Maria Gonzalez) was counted as a direct care nurse when she was actually doing administrative rounds. Have you reviewed?

Miranda, I reviewed those shifts personally. Maria was PROVIDING direct patient care on those nights — she was doing both charge duties AND bedside care. So she absolutely counts toward the ratio. We were compliant. The inspector is wrong.

The regulation is clear — Title 22 § 70217(c) says the charge nurse only counts when 'actively engaged in the direct care of patients', not when performing administrative duties. The staffing log shows her as 'Charge/Admin Rounds' for those shifts. We need to correct the log and acknowledge the violations.
I'll defer to Legal's interpretation. But for the record, I believe those shifts were compliant based on what I observed.
